title: The Day A Giant Blue Plush Beat an Ancient Demon

title: ASI resumes excavation at Dron Sagar mound in Uttarakhand’s Kashipur to study ancient remains
description: The Archaeological Survey of India (ASI) has resumed excavation at a mound near Dron Sagar in Kashipur, Uttarakhand, to scientifically examine archaeological remains and investigate the site's history, including local beliefs linking it to the Mahabharata-era sage Dronacharya.
